decision: The Competitor (Williams Martini Racing) is fined €300.
event_name: Williams Martini Racing Document 11 Date 24 May 2018 Time 13:05 2018 MONACO GRAND PRIX 23 - 27 May 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
